label: 12-literature
question: Is there published literature on file about AI radiology software failures? Cite PMIDs.
answer: Yes, stored literature on AI radiology software includes PMID 31594798 on ischemic stroke and large vessel occlusion detection, PMID 37541274 on AI-supported mammography screening, and PMID 36350524 on lung cancer imaging. It also includes PMID 35943350 on false-negative and false-positive outcomes of computer-aided detection for brain metastasis, PMID 32531273 on AI for breast cancer detection in mammography, and PMID 34785617 on stroke diagnostics and radiologic interpretation.
